h1: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Kadapa

h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Kadapa

items.pText: Kadapa lies in the Rayalaseema region of Andhra Pradesh, ringed by the Palakonda hills, with hot, dry weather for most of the year. Schools, colleges, municipal parks and housing layouts here often come to us with a fixed budget and ask what it can buy. FunPlay Systems makes playground equipment at our factory in Vasai, about 830 km away, and delivers it by road.

A playground budget has to cover more than the equipment. Delivery, installation, foundations and the surface under the equipment all come out of the same amount. Buyers who spend everything on a large station sometimes end up with bare, hard ground beneath it. Tell us your budget along with the site size and age group, and we will suggest a plan that covers every part and leaves nothing half-done. We would rather plan a smaller play area done well.

props.h2Text: How would you like to start?
props.pText: Turn your playground dreams to reality

c: Start with the surface. Rubber flooring under at least the fall zones of slides, swings and climbers belongs in the first order, since it protects children every day. Next, choose equipment for the main age group before adding pieces for others. Ask for installation and foundation work to be quoted along with the equipment, so nothing comes as a surprise later. On a tight budget, a few well-placed individual pieces with proper flooring serve children better than a big station on hard soil.

facts.label: Distance
facts.value: About 830 km from our Vasai factory (straight line)

facts.label: Delivery and installation
facts.value: By road from Vasai; installed by our team or a local dealer

items.q: What should a playground budget include?
items.a: The equipment, delivery, installation, foundation work and the surface under the play area. Share your total budget with us and we will suggest a plan that covers each part.

items.q: Can we add more equipment later?
items.a: Yes. We can mark space for future pieces on the layout drawing, so later additions fit without moving anything that is already installed. Many schools in Rayalaseema start with a few pieces and add more over two or three budget years.
Yes. We send equipment from our Vasai factory to Kadapa by road, and our installation team or a dealer in Andhra Pradesh installs it on site.
